1. i almost threw away that bent black umbrella behind the coats this morning, until i noticed which spoke was broken. 2. the metal rib on the left snapped years ago, bent completely flat to one side. 3. you carried it every morning down the hill, through all of year seven. 4. so you kept your elbow locked straight, holding the canvas tilted high over my side. 5. my blazer was completely dry every time we reached the school gate. 6. but your own left sleeve was soaked through to the skin by eight o'clock. 7. you never once told me to walk faster, or asked me to take a turn with the handle. 8. i hung it back up today, because you took the weather for both of us.
✍️ Caption
my older brother never made a speech about looking after anyone. he just walked on the curb side of the pavement every morning. send this to the person who took the wet shoulder so you didn't have to. #siblings #brotherandsister #oldersiblings #growingupwithsiblings
